topic: API endpoint for tracking panel changes
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on developing an API endpoint for Ramboll to track changes in advertising panels. The required functionality is an endpoint that returns a list of panels that have changed within a specified time period (the last week). If no changes are detected, the endpoint should return an empty list or null.

[me] confirmed that such an endpoint can be built. [p1] clarified that the parameters for this endpoint should include a start date and end date in UTC format.
decisions: An API endpoint will be created to provide a list of changed panels within a specified period.
action_items: [me] needs to implement the API endpoint with start/end date parameters (UTC).
